regions.today: It will be rather cloudy this afternoon with an isolated shower. There may also be some bright spells, mainly in southern and eastern parts. Turning cloudier this evening with some scattered showers or patchy rain across the northern half of Leinster. Highest temperatures of 18 to 20 degrees in light to moderate southwest breezes.
regions.tonight: Generally cloudy and dry for most at first tonight. However, further cloud and rain will arrive from the south-west overnight. These will turn heavy in places. Lowest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees with light to moderate south to southeast winds, fresher along coasts.
regions.tomorrow: Cloud and outbreaks of rain will quickly clear north-eastwards during the early morning. It will turn drier and brighter from the south-west throughout the late morning and afternoon, with some bright breaks developing. However, further patches of rain or showers may develop too. Highest temperatures of 19 to 21 degrees with mostly moderate southwest winds.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate on Tuesday and Wednesday.
